backup.title: Data backup
backup.description: Back up the database with the local mysqldump / mariadb-dump / pg_dump and keep compressed copies. Restore is command-line only (no web entry).
backup.started: Backup started; the list refreshes automatically
backup.deleteConfirm: Delete backup "{{name}}"? The file is removed from disk as well.

unavailable.title: Cannot back up: dump tool missing
unavailable.detail: Not found on this host: {{tools}}. Install the dump tool and add it to PATH

empty.title: No backups yet
empty.restoreHint: Stop the service first, then run the command below; a pre-restore backup is taken automatically and you must confirm.

settings.title: Backup settings
settings.description: Schedule and retention are stored in the database and shared by all instances; only one instance runs the job.
settings.scheduleHint: Runs once a day at a fixed time (application time zone); a missed run is made up once the service is back that day.
settings.keepHint: When both are set, a backup is removed if either rule matches; the newest successful backup is always kept.
